description: Looping dashed sine-like stroke built from cubic segments, wiped on the right by a paper mask; hue, weight and amplitude set by sliders
notable: Dash length is measured from an SVG path's getTotalLength so the dash rhythm tracks the amplitude slider exactly

description: Five-point star with independently rounded convex and concave corners, shown filled, as a ring, or as a wireframe with vertex nodes
notable: The reference sketch for the canvas-UI shell: modes, sliders, hatch-on-magnify and the loupe all exercised on one shape

description: Four stacked relief fills, each a matter-js spring chain hung between grid corners and settling under gravity; draggable seed points
notable: Ports the original's OKLCH clamp on purpose: L=100 c=70 is out of gamut and the channel clamp turns it into a saturated hue

description: Seven white blocks hanging from the top edge, each twisted about its vertical axis; front and back faces split at bezier intersections
notable: Front/back faces come from intersecting the outer bezier of one edge with the inner bezier of the other and splitting both at t

description: Napoleon's theorem: equilateral triangles erected on a draggable triangle, their centroids joined into a green equilateral triangle
notable: apex() falls back to erecting along the side normal when a right angle puts the circumcentre exactly on the side's midpoint

description: Napoleon's construction on a noise-wandering triangle, the gaps to the canvas corners fanned out as flat red, yellow and blue planes
notable: Vertices wander on 2D noise sampled around a circle so the 24 s loop closes; the drift slider scales the wander from zero

description: A regular polygon whose vertices slide toward edge midpoints, cutting off the corners; white over orange on a green, peach and yellow ground
notable: A fractional vertex count yields ceil(n) vertices spaced 360/n apart: the original's non-closing polygons, kept deliberately

description: Napoleon's construction fanned to the four corners, every triangle hatched with lines from two vertices, as a blue lattice on off-white
notable: Same Napoleon fan as flatland-waltz rendered as a ruled lattice; the splits slider sets how many hatch lines each triangle gets
